values.highlights: Handover ran on time all day, and the new admission checklist saved time in the afternoon.
values.concerns: Two staff short after lunch. Breaks ran late for most of the team.

values.description: A family member was upset that a discharge was delayed. I explained what was happening, but I was interrupted twice and the conversation was rushed.
values.feelings: Frustrated with myself at the time. Afterwards I realised I had been trying to answer while doing another task.
values.evaluation: The information I gave was right. The setting wasn’t: a corridor, while I was busy, didn’t help anyone feel heard.
action-plan: [ ] Find a quiet space for difficult conversations
[ ] Ask a colleague to cover for five minutes when I need it

topics: [x] Managing difficult conversations on a busy shift
values.notes: We talked about setting a time for a conversation rather than having it in passing. Helen suggested a short course on communication skills.
